snippet.title: Eden's Prison - Official Trailer (2d psychedelic platformer)
snippet.description:
https://dylancassidy.itch.io/edens-prison

Eden's Prison is a perspective shifting 2d platformer. The goal is to climb as high as possible by bouncing on the ledges. Collecting items causes subtle changes to the tower itself, which is an optical illusion. Levels are randomly generated.

Check out my other games here: https://dylancassidy.itch.io/
